title: Chido — Furniture in Your Space
summary: A browser-based spatial design experiment exploring furniture selection, placement and scale through AR and interactive web interfaces.
role: Interaction design, AR prototyping and real-time 3D workflows
details: Chido explores a practical gap between a furniture catalog and a purchasing decision: seeing a product at a believable scale inside a real room. The linked public demo includes a showroom-style entry point and access to the interactive experiment.
challenge: Customers can see dimensions in a catalog and still struggle to imagine a sofa, chair or table within the space where it will actually be used.
approach: Use browser-based AR and a reference-measurement workflow to make product placement more tangible, while keeping the experience accessible from a normal website.
highlights: A furniture-facing website linked to a spatial experience
Exploration of placement, scale and product arrangement
AR access requires a compatible device and browser
